insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, starting in API version 2026-10. This change aims to prevent silently returning incorrect results. The API will explicitly indicate when a metafield is not configured for filtering.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their GraphQL queries to ensure they are only filtering by metafields that are properly set up. This change may break existing queries that relied on the previous behavior, so it's essential to test and update them accordingly. The GraphQL Admin API's new behavior will help prevent unexpected results, but it requires developers to adapt their queries to the new rules.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice improvements in the accuracy of data returned by apps using the GraphQL Admin API, as incorrect results due to misconfigured metafields will be explicitly flagged.
insight.why_it_matters: This change enhances the reliability and accuracy of data retrieved through the GraphQL Admin API, which is crucial for building robust and trustworthy Shopify apps.
insight.code_example: query { products(metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including metafield changes, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI has been updated to fix a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, which may break existing apps.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated to add non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include a unique name for each app, to reduce merchant confusion.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports a channelId argument, allowing for more specific sales channel context.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: The POS UI Extensions API now includes discount allocations to bundle components, starting with version 2026-07.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, Expanded Webhooks, and Improved Liquid Templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries in API version 2026-10, ensuring more accurate results. This change affects queries filtering by metafields not set up for filtering, which previously returned incorrect results silently.

themes.title: Webhooks and Events Expansion
themes.detail: New metafield triggers and topics are available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources like Order, Collection, and Location, as well as metafield changes on Product, Order, Customer, Collection, and Location.

themes.title: Liquid Templates and App Development
themes.detail: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building. Additionally, full-stack capabilities are introduced to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics without standing up their own stack.
